tldr: Exact safety and exact observable-proxy certification have different phase behavior. A total fresh-key randomized-rank policy is proxy-safe at every sample size and attains the Hölder rate \(n^{-s/(2s+d)}\). On the compensated sign class, proxy regret has that rate while unrestricted-safe regret is zero because the oracle is public. On the paired-boundary experiment, and on every fixed class between that experiment and one constructed ambient Hölder ball, both safe and proxy minimax regrets have the same matched rate. This inclusion result concerns the displayed constants and budget, not arbitrary Hölder balls or every law considered by Jin--Egami.
gap: JinEgami2026 establishes exact finite-sample harm safety and qualitative asymptotic welfare optimality, ScaudaFreidlingZhao2026 Lemma 1 and Theorem 2 characterize population lexical harm-constrained oracles, and BenMichaelImaiJiang2024 identifies weighted loss from learning a nuisance-dependent branch. The literature does not quantify the minimax welfare price of requiring a learned observable arm to certify a sharp harm budget or compare that price on the same law class with unrestricted exact safety.
fill: The project combines a randomized-rank exact-safety rule, an integrated Hölder nuisance bound, and a compensated Assouad hypercube whose abstention bridge charges both wrong-arm treatment and treatment withdrawal. It proves the proxy rate and zero unrestricted-safe regret only on that fixed class, without treating the known sharp-harm formula, the population threshold oracle, or their algebraic regret identity as independent novelties.
